name: Agent Performance Dashboard
description: Real-time monitoring of AI agent performance and metrics

cards.name: Total Conversations
cards.description: Total number of conversations across all agents

native.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_conversations
FROM agent_logs 
WHERE created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]
  AND ({{agent_filter}} IS NULL OR agent_name = {{agent_filter}})

cards.name: Active Agents
cards.description: Number of agents that processed requests in the last 24 hours

native.query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT agent_name) as active_agents
FROM agent_logs 
WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day'
  AND ({{agent_filter}} IS NULL OR agent_name = {{agent_filter}})

cards.name: Agent Response Times
cards.description: Average response time by agent over selected period

native.query:
SELECT 
    agent_name,
    ROUND(AVG(response_time)::numeric, 2) as avg_response_time
FROM agent_logs 
WHERE created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]
  AND ({{agent_filter}} IS NULL OR agent_name = {{agent_filter}})
GROUP BY agent_name
ORDER BY avg_response_time DESC

cards.name: Success Rate by Agent
cards.description: Success rate percentage for each agent

native.query:
SELECT 
    agent_name,
    ROUND((COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'success' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*))::numeric, 2) as success_rate
FROM agent_logs 
WHERE created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]
  AND ({{agent_filter}} IS NULL OR agent_name = {{agent_filter}})
GROUP BY agent_name
ORDER BY success_rate DESC

cards.name: Agent Usage Over Time
cards.description: Agent usage trends over the selected time period

native.query:
SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at) as date,
    agent_name,
    COUNT(*) as usage_count
FROM agent_logs 
WHERE created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]
  AND ({{agent_filter}} IS NULL OR agent_name = {{agent_filter}})
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at), agent_name
ORDER BY date

cards.name: Error Rate Trends
cards.description: Daily error rates across all agents

native.query:
SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at) as date,
    ROUND((COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'error' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*))::numeric, 2) as error_rate
FROM agent_logs 
WHERE created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]
  AND ({{agent_filter}} IS NULL OR agent_name = {{agent_filter}})
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at)
ORDER BY date

cards.name: Top Error Messages
cards.description: Most common error messages and their frequency

native.query:
SELECT 
    error_message,
    COUNT(*) as error_count,
    ROUND((COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER ())::numeric, 2) as percentage
FROM agent_logs 
WHERE status = 'error'
  AND created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]
  AND ({{agent_filter}} IS NULL OR agent_name = {{agent_filter}})
  AND error_message IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY error_message
ORDER BY error_count DESC
LIMIT 10

cards.name: Agent Performance Heatmap
cards.description: Hourly performance heatmap showing peak usage times

native.query:
SELECT 
    EXTRACT(hour FROM created_at) as hour,
    EXTRACT(dow FROM created_at) as day_of_week,
    COUNT(*) as request_count,
    AVG(response_time) as avg_response_time
FROM agent_logs 
WHERE created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]
  AND ({{agent_filter}} IS NULL OR agent_name = {{agent_filter}})
GROUP BY EXTRACT(hour FROM created_at), EXTRACT(dow FROM created_at)
ORDER BY day_of_week, hour
